skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Rules that never bend' says 'Never drops the deferred tax on an adjustment', but 'Stage 1 — Intake' (questions B–F) and the upload checklist never ask for the tax rate, so on an upload run deferred tax can only ever be shown as 'difference × rate, rate needed'.

references/method.md 'Step 1 — Scope the conversion' marks development costs live only 'if the accounts show R&D expense, or capitalised development intangibles', while references/edge-cases.md 'An account's absence is treated as proof' says absence is 'a scoping signal, not a conclusion'; the two give opposite instructions on whether an absent area is ruled out or flagged.

references/method.md 'Step 1' leases row calls rent with no lease liability 'an unrecognised conversion issue', but for a US GAAP private company after ASC 842 adoption it is first a source-GAAP error; nothing tells the run to split the bridge into the source-GAAP correction and the true framework difference.

SKILL.md 'Stage 1' question C distinguishes 'group reporting' from 'first-time adoption' but gives no rule on whether a subsidiary reporting to an IFRS parent applies IFRS 1 (or the parent's transition date), so Step 5's applicability is left to the run.

references/method.md 'Step 6 — Build the reconciliation' says the source figures must be 'tied to the connected books'; on upload there is no statement of what to tie them to when only a TB, not issued statements, is supplied.
sample_defects: Key expects development costs flagged, but nothing in the sample supports it: no R&D account in the TB and no development policy in accounting_policies.md; a run following method.md Step 1 rules it out.
Manifest calls lease_terms.md 'Key terms of two property leases', but the second lease is an office printer (12 months, 180/month), not property.
lease_terms.md escalates rent 3% each January from a 1 Jan 2024 start, so 2025 rent is 9,270/month (9 × 9,270 = 83,430), but the TB shows 6100 Rent 81,000 = 9 × 9,000; unkeyed inconsistency.
TB has no tax accounts on 605,615 of profit, so the keyed 'deferred tax on each adjustment' cannot be quantified from the sample (no rate supplied either).

Arithmetic check: wrong-year TB is identifiable from content — RE 1,422,317 − 789,221 = 633,096 (one year's profit); accumulated depreciation 311,200 − 260,800 = 50,400 = 12 × 4,200; loan 280,000 − 220,000 = 60,000 = 12 × 5,000.
summary: PARTIAL 1/2; Sep-2024 TB rejected on content. Development costs ruled out (no R&D in data); skill never asks the tax rate its deferred-tax rule needs.
